messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: GPU_POOL_SATURATION in gcp-europe-west8 — autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (quota denied). queue_len=820, inflight=610, p95_gen_latency=3.2s. Paging oncall.

maya (oncall): ack — I'm on it. pulling dashboards. which customers are impacted?

ops-bot: metric alert: inference.queue.size > 500 for 6m (gcp-europe-west8). autoscaler.events: 24x quotaExceeded errors in last 10m.

raj (sre): seeing same. autoscaler logs: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-15T01:07:04Z autoscaler: failed to create instance: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPU_ALL_REGIONS' exceeded for project: compute.googleapis.com, quotaLimit: 100, quotaUsage: 100
```

carlos (infra): confirmed — it's GCP quota cap for GPUs in europe-west8. Warm-pool had ~12 reserved GPUs, but we can't expand beyond account quota.

maya (oncall): customer-impact? emma, can you pull support hits?

emma (support): live tickets: 3 customers reporting slow responses / queued requests. internal logs show elevated 429s for non-realtime routes when queue > 600. No full request failures yet, just high latency and longer queue times. Customers: acme-inc (severity 2), shopify-co (severity 3), beta-app (severity 3).

zara (customer-ops): flagged to acme-inc PM. they're seeing latency spikes on batch reranks. we told them we're investigating.

raj (sre): immediate mitigations: 1) stop non-critical background batch jobs in region, 2) evict warm pool reservations, 3) enable cross-region reroute to europe-west4, 4) fall back non-SLA traffic to CPU model variant. Which is fastest?

carlos (infra): I'll evict warm pool and kill low-priority pods now.
```
kubectl delete pods -l job=batch-lowprio -n inference --grace-period=0
gcloud compute instance-templates update warm-pool-eu-west8 --accelerator-count=0
```

carlos (infra): done. freed ~14 GPUs (should drop queue pressure in 90s).

maya (oncall): enabling reroute policy for non-critical routes -> europe-west4. ops-bot, apply policy 'reroute:eu4-noncritical'

ops-bot: policy applied: reroute non-critical inference traffic to gcp-europe-west4. estimated reduction: ~35% load.

raj (sre): also pushing model-fallback: config change to prefer smaller quantized model for non-SLA tier.

neil (product): confirm the fallback quality checks? we need to inform customers that lower-cost model may change outputs.

maya (oncall): we added note on status page: "Degraded performance for some inference requests in europe-west8. Mitigations in progress" — statuspage.io/rdw/incident/1789456789 (internal).

carlos (infra): opened quota request with GCP: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-inference (request id Q-74291). earliest response ETA unknown but flagged as high.

emma (support): communication: I've updated the three customers with current mitigations and ETA unknown. acme-inc asked if cross-region failover is safe — answered yes for non-sensitive data.

maya (oncall): monitoring: queue_len down to 420 after evictions/reroute. p95 latency 1.5s and trending down. still above target.

raj (sre): note: autoscaler still reporting quotaDenied for new pools, so long-term we need quota bump or reduce simultaneous allocation attempts. I'll throttle autoscale requests to avoid hitting meta-quota.

raj (sre): patch: set autoscaler.maxParallelCreates=2 for europe-west8 to spread attempts.
```
# infra config
autoscaler:
  region: europe-west8
  maxParallelCreates: 2
```

carlos (infra): applied. should reduce repeated quotaDenied noise in logs.

ops-bot: alert suppression: silence gpu-quota-errors in europe-west8 for 30m (investigation window).

maya (oncall): handing to night shift: neil will lead follow-up and coordinate quota request / re-enable warm pool if quota increases. I will write quick incident doc and hand off.

neil (product): taking handoff. monitoring dashboard pinned. will check once per 30m and update this thread. please add any action items to the incident doc.

maya (oncall): action items drafted: [investigate root cause of quota consumption], [request regional GPU quota increase], [review warm-pool reservation policy], [postmortem and customer communication]. assigning to raj/carlos/neil.

zara (customer-ops): saved notes and follow-ups. will coordinate a post-incident call with acme-inc tomorrow if needed.

maya (oncall): final: queue_len 310, p95 1.0s. marking incident as "mitigated" for active paging — handing off. please keep monitoring until quota resolved. :white_check_mark:
